_comment: The release label for the whole toolkit. Bump it deliberately when you
publish; build_manifest.py stamps it into manifest.json and every
artifact URL, and publish.py uses it as the bucket directory.
Deliberately NOT derived from a git tag: distribution is bucket +
manifest (and native .exe/.dmg installers), not GitHub releases, so the
release label is ours to set rather than something git hands us.
